plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels often retells a moment from the Ariel School case, a 1994 event at a school in Ruwa, Zimbabwe, where children said they saw visitors from a craft. A Harvard psychiatrist named John Mack later interviewed the children, and Michels says one girl told him, "In space there's no love, but down here there is." In one telling Mack was asking how the beings spoke to the children by thought, and in another he was asking why the visitors had come. Michels shares it because, if true, it hints at why such beings might be interested in Earth.
